title: Indian-Style Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Indian-inspired stir fry made with mixed vegetables and a hint of pesto.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the pesto, Saudia, and salt. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Cook time may vary based on your desired level of doneness.
Adjust the amount of pesto to your taste, as it can be quite strong.
You can also add protein like chicken or tofu to make it a more substantial meal.
Stir-fry is a quick and versatile dish, so feel free to experiment with different vegetables and seasonings.
